name: Dominance-Regime Conditioned BTC-to-ALT Residual Follower
research_question: Among pre-frozen BTC-plus-residual follower signals, does contemporaneous BTC.D/USDT.D/TOTAL3 regime confirmation add reproducible incremental information about subsequent ALT returns after costs?

anti_duplication.h180: Simple hourly BTC-to-ALT lead-lag already closed NO EDGE.
anti_duplication.ll_0004: BTC-factor residual mean-reversion/continuation already tested; same residual-z mechanism may not be reopened.
anti_duplication.family_e_f08: Raw cross-sectional relative strength and factor-adjusted residual ranking already tested and later failed OOS.
anti_duplication.queue06: F07 rotation was recognized as overlapping but the exact dominance-conditioned residual-follower contract was not executed.
anti_duplication.novel_dimension: Incremental regime information from BTC.D, USDT.D and TOTAL3 applied prospectively to an otherwise frozen BTC-plus-residual follower baseline.

source_contract.binance: checksum-verified Binance USD-M Futures 1m historical data

temporal_governance.note: This split modernizes governance before any ARQ-001 market outcome is opened; it does not change the legacy signal defaults.

signal_semantics.beta: strictly backward-looking rolling 30-day beta of ALT 1m returns on BTC 1m returns
signal_semantics.gap: ALT 180s log return - beta * BTC 180s log return
signal_semantics.normalization: causal rolling z-scores using prior 30 calendar days only; current event excluded

ablation.primary_incremental_test: D-confirmed versus D-rejected baseline signals at 5m, plus D-confirmed net expectancy > 0

costs_bps_round_trip.derivation: 4 bps taker fee per fill plus 1/2/3 bps slippage per fill

statistics.multiple_testing: BH-FDR 5% across five ALT primary tests
mandatory_robustness: positive D-confirmed minus D-rejected baseline delta
bootstrap lower 95% bound for primary pooled D-confirmed net expectancy > 0
at least 3 of 5 ALTs positive at BASE12
remove best 1% trades and remain positive at BASE12
remove best ALT and remain positive at BASE12
top-of-hour effect must exceed predeclared placebo-hour diagnostics
